request: MAG-72 — clean up telemetry integration-test fixtures in vehicle_snapshots. Investigation found the ticket's premise wrong: telemetry's tests clean up correctly; internal/analytics/db_integration_test.go inserts into telemetry.vehicle_snapshots without deleting it, and internal/testdb reads DATABASE_URL so any test run that sees it uses the real dev database. Scope agreed with the owner: read TEST_DATABASE_URL instead, fix the analytics cleanup, sweep stale docs, add a one-off cleanup script for the 78 existing rows, and document magus_test as the opt-in target.

decisions.decision: keep all three parts on MAG-72 rather than splitting into new tickets
decisions.why: MAG-72 was the cleanup ticket; the owner chose to widen it after the real cause was found

decisions.decision: owning module is platform, as one change, not a roadmap
decisions.why: config.yaml reserves platform for cross-cutting work; a roadmap is heavy for a four-file fix

decisions.decision: one-off SQL script run by hand, not a goose migration
decisions.why: the orphan rows exist only on dev; a migration would run on every environment forever

decisions.decision: keep magus_test and document it as the opt-in TEST_DATABASE_URL target
decisions.why: it already exists and is unreferenced; the container stays the default because a hand-kept database drifts

decisions.decision: added a platform capability delta after strict validation rejected the change
decisions.why: the leader wrongly told the worker a delta was optional; the spec-driven schema requires one

decisions.decision: replaced psql "$ADMIN" -d "$DB" with a single positional admin URI aimed at the test database
decisions.why: -d takes the dbname slot, so the URI became a username and the host was dropped; verified by reproducing the FATAL

decisions.decision: also corrected README's claim that make test can never touch the real database
decisions.why: true of the old env -u target, false now that make test is plain go test and honours TEST_DATABASE_URL
